data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghara', meaning 'to decide'. This name signifies the strength and determination of one who makes a firm decision. The name Ghareezat carries the meaning “Decision, Resolve, Determination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghareezat usually hope their child will grow to embody decision, resolve, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Ghareezat is the name of a famous battle fought between the Islamic army and the Byzantine and Sasanian Empires in 624 AD.
historical_references.context: The Battle of Ghareezat took place near the city of Mu'tah in present-day Jordan. It is considered a significant victory for the Islamic forces, as it marked the first major military engagement of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) outside of Arabia.
